rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
History is interpretation, not just dates — link every historical fact to its cultural meaning.
For 'history and culture' questions, always connect past events to present identity.

rows.text: Trick 1: Unit-theme questions ask you to CONNECT the text to Nepali context — always end an answer with one sentence applying the theme to Nepal (heritage tourism, cultural preservation).  ·  Trick 2: For 'history and culture' passages, watch for dates, dynasties and customs in comprehension questions — underline them while reading; most factual questions quote them directly.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: Q. How does understanding history help us understand the present? (2 marks) — present institutions and conflicts have historical roots; history explains current values.
